jobs.description:
When even the smallest deviations in semiconductor manufacturing can have a significant impact, a keen eye for detail is essential. In Defect Engineering, you systematically investigate defect patterns, identify process weaknesses and contribute to the continuous improvement of our manufacturing processes and technology developments. In doing so, you combine data analysis with modern inspection methods and collaborate closely with various specialist departments.

Number of positions to be filled: 2

Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role

- Independently handling work packages within development projects as well as in production, with a focus on identifying process weaknesses and causes of failure- Supporting the adherence to project timelines and ensuring line stability through continuous data analysis and the application of various inspection techniques- Defining inspection steps along the chip production process- Conducting and supporting experiments within development projects as well as for the implementation of process improvements- Documenting results and handing them over to production- Taking ownership of department-specific projects

Your profile

You have strong analytical skills and enjoy systematically getting to the bottom of complex technical challenges. You enjoy working in a team, exchanging knowledge with others and contributing your own ideas to improve processes and ways of working.

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

- University degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics or Chemistry- Ideally 1–3 years of relevant professional experience- Knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing processes and their interdependencies- Experience with electron microscopy and/or optical inspection and/or measurement technologies- Proficiency in both German and English

#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.
As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.
Are you in?

We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.

We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity.
Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.
Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.

The Max Planck Society is one of the leading research organizations in Europe. We offer challenging tasks with a high degree of personal responsibility and creative freedom in research laboratories, workshops, libraries and administration.

The Max Planck Society strives to increase employment of severely disabled people. Applications from severely disabled people are expressly encouraged.

Furthermore, the Max Planck Society wants to increase the proportion of women in areas where they are underrepresented. Women are therefore expressly encouraged to apply.

The Little Pumpkins Parents' Association offers childcare for children under the age of 3 at the MPIPZ.

It is possible to apply for a low-cost Germany job ticket with a subsidy from the Institute. The institute also has a rental bike station run by the provider nextbike, as well as the possibility of using rental scooters from various providers.

The Department of Comparative Development and Genetics at the Max Planck Institute for Plant Breeding Research (MPIPZ) in Cologne is seeking to fill

2 x Research Support positions (m/f/d) to contribute to our daily laboratory work on mechanisms underlying plant development and diversity. The successful applicants will work in close collaboration with experienced research technicians and scientists at different levels and they will cultivate and characterize developmental traits in plant strains derived from mutagenesis and wild collections as well as transgenic plants. They will also be involved in generation of new transgenic plants. Experience in molecular biology (genomic DNA extraction, PCR, cloning), and in handling and cultivating plants, as well as experience with plant genetics is essential (further information on our research: https://www.mpipz.mpg.de/tsiantis). Experience working with Arabidopsis, including the generation of transgenic plants and CRISPR/Cas mutants, is a strong asset. Experience with single cell approaches is also of interest. Additional tasks will involve maintaining lab genetic collections, preparing culture media and assisting in organizing and daily running of an S1 lab. The level of independent work and responsibility will depend on qualifications.
Successful candidates will have completed professional training as either a research technician with first professional experience, or as a biology graduate (B.Sc. in plant genetics or an equivalent discipline) with work experience or an additional educational qualification. We are searching for highly motivated candidates with an organized working style and highly developed teamwork skills. Applicants should be enthusiastic about scientific research in an international environment. Excellent documentation skills, computer literacy (Microsoft Office, Electronic lab book applications) as well as fluent English are required.
We offer stimulating and multi-faceted positions (full-time employment) in a friendly and international environment. Payment and benefits are according to the German TVöD and will depend on experience, knowledge and qualifications. The positions are for one year, starting as early as possible and no later than February 2027, with the possibility of renewal.

jobs.description:
The University Medical Center Schleswig-Holstein (UKSH) combines world-class international research with interdisciplinary patient care. We are the state's only comprehensive care provider and its largest employer. Our approximately 17,500 employees ensure highly personalized care—which is indispensable for the people of Schleswig-Holstein.
The University Hospital Schleswig-Holstein (UKSH) with its locations in Kiel and Lübeck is one of the largest medical care centers in Europe. It serves to warrant maximum medical care in the northernmost federal state and guarantees medical-technical care at the highest level, especially for patients who require highly differentiated diagnosis and therapy. The unique feature of university medicine is the interaction of health care, research and teaching with the result that scientific findings flow directly into the health system.

Our research aims to develop novel diagnostic and therapeutic strategies for chronic inflammatory diseases, including inflammatory bowel, liver, lung and skin diseases. To achieve this, we investigate the cellular and molecular mechanisms underlying immune regulation in different disease contexts and employ state-of-the-art technologies to comprehensively characterize human immune cells, with a particular focus on antigen-specific CD4+ T cells. A major focus of our research is the integration of high-dimensional single-cell and immune repertoire data. Our group combines enrichment of rare antigen-specific CD4+ T cells with multidimensional flow cytometry, single-cell RNA sequencing, T cell receptor sequencing and ATAC sequencing to investigate cellular states, immune cell differentiation, clonality and regulatory mechanisms in health and disease.

As a PhD student / postdoctoral researcher in bioinformatics, you will be an integral part of the research activities within our group. You will develop and pursue independent research projects and also contribute to a broad range of collaborative projects involving different members of the group. Your work will focus on the computational analysis, integration and interpretation of high-dimensional sequencing data, with particular emphasis on:

- Analysis of single-cell RNA sequencing, T cell receptor sequencing, and ATAC sequencing data
- Integration of transcriptomic, TCR, epigenetic and flow cytometry data to characterize immune cell states and regulatory mechanisms
- Development and application of reproducible bioinformatics workflows and analysis pipelines, including data visualization and interpretation
- Active contribution to diverse collaborative projects within the group, including the planning and design of computational analyses in close interaction with experimental scientists

Start in our team:
Join our research team starting from February 1st 2027. The position is initially limited to two years, with the possibility of extension. We are looking forward to welcoming you as part of our team with all your skills and commitment.

What we offer:

- Salary will be according to the German salary scale TV-L (German TV-L E13, PhD student 65%, Postdoc 100%)
- A full-time position, currently 38,5 hours/week; part-time employment may be compatible within the framework of certain working time models
- Exceptional technical infrastructure especially for multi-dimensional flow-cytometry and for next generation sequencing at the the Institute of Medical Immunology and the Center of Molecular Biosciences (ZMB)
- You can find more exciting benefits offered by the UKSH here:Benefits (uksh.de)

What you can expect:

- A fascinating research environment for the investigation of basic processes of human immune reactions with direct implications for immune-mediated diseases
- A systematic training to work independently in a challenging and diversified research field
- The opportunity to work in a dedicated, supportive and international research team
- An extensive pool of sophisticated methods and complex laboratory instruments

Whatyou bring with you:
University degree (Master's or equivalent) in bioinformatics, computational biology, biology, biostatistics, data science or a related field; completed PhD required for postdoctoral positions

Strong interest in single-cell omics, immunology and computational analysis of biological data

Experience with next-generation sequencing technologies (e.g. scRNA-seq, TCR-seq or ATAC-seq) is desirable

Good programming skills in R and/or Python, including the development, adaptation and documentation of computational workflows

High degree of commitment, independence, organizational skills and responsibility, along with strong communication skills in English and the ability to collaborate effectively with experimental and clinical teams

We look forward to receiving your application (CV, motivation letter stating research and career interests, copies of education certificates, and two letters of recommendation) by 29.10.2026; please include job posting number 29445.

jobs.occupation: Manager of Insurance Tax, Regulation & Compliance Germany (m/f/d) (Fachanwalt/-anwältin - Steuerrecht)
jobs.description:
Shape compliance. Drive governance. Protect global business.
 

At DHL Group, we connect people and improve lives through our global logistics network. Behind our world-leading operations stands a strong commitment to governance, compliance, and risk management. We are looking for an experienced Manager of Insurance Tax, Regulation & Compliance Germany (m/f/d) to play a pivotal role in ensuring that our insurance activities remain compliant, transparent, and future-ready. This position combines insurance taxation, regulatory compliance, governance, and stakeholder management in a highly international environment.
 

Manager of Insurance Tax, Regulation & Compliance Germany (m/f/d)
   

Why experienced insurance professionals join this role
* Move from advising to owning insurance governance decisions.
* Shape multinational insurance programs across a global organization.
* Influence strategic decisions involving Tax, Legal, Treasury, Procurement, and Risk Management.
* Work at the intersection of insurance, regulation, governance, and business strategy.
* Gain exposure to some of the most complex international insurance arrangements in the market.

 

You'll make an impact by:
* Defining and evolving DHL Group's global insurance governance framework.
* Ensuring regulatory excellence across international insurance programs.
* Leading complex tax, regulatory, and compliance initiatives.
* Managing interactions with authorities, regulators, auditors, brokers, and insurers.
* Providing strategic guidance on multinational insurance structures and cross-border risk solutions.

 

What You Will Do:

Insurance Tax & Compliance
* Serve as the central expert for insurance premium tax matters in Germany.
* Advise business stakeholders on insurance taxation, insurance distribution compliance, and regulatory requirements.
* Assess domestic and international insurance programs, including multinational insurance structures, global master policies, local policies, captive insurance arrangements, and Freedom of Services (FOS) solutions.
* Review and evaluate insurance premium tax treatment for insurance contracts and insurance-related services.
* Support the design, implementation, and launch of new insurance programs while ensuring tax and regulatory compliance. Governance & Risk Management

* Maintain and continuously improve insurance tax governance and compliance frameworks.
* Design and oversee internal control systems for insurance premium tax processes.
* Contribute to the enhancement of DHL Group's Tax Compliance Management System.
* Conduct risk assessments and compliance reviews related to insurance distribution and taxation.
* Promote transparency, documentation standards, and audit readiness across the organization. 

 

Regulatory & Audit Management
* Manage insurance premium tax audits and regulatory reviews independently.
* Act as the primary contact for tax authorities, auditors, legal advisors, insurers, and brokers.
* Develop strategies to address audit findings and mitigate regulatory risks.
* Monitor developments in German and international insurance tax legislation and relevant court decisions.
* Ensure regulatory awareness and compliance regarding insurance distribution activities in Germany.

 

Cross-Functional Collaboration
* Work closely with colleagues from Tax, Legal, Treasury, Procurement, Risk Management, and other business functions.
* Support DHL business units in understanding and meeting insurance compliance requirements.
* Coordinate with external advisors, brokers, insurers, and regulatory stakeholders across multiple jurisdictions.

 

What You Bring
* University degree in Law, Tax, Business Administration, Finance, Insurance, Risk Management, or a related field.
* Several years of professional experience in insurance taxation, insurance regulation, compliance, risk management, legal, or related disciplines.
* Proven expertise in German Insurance Premium Tax (IPT) regulations and insurance compliance requirements.
* Experience managing regulatory inquiries, audits, disputes, and complex multinational insurance programs.
* Strong understanding of commercial insurance products, including Property, Liability, Marine, Cargo, Cyber, D&O, Financial Lines, and Employee Benefits.
* Experience developing governance, control, and compliance frameworks in international organizations.
* Excellent English language skills and good German language proficiency.

 

Who You Are

You are a strategic and analytical professional who enjoys navigating complex regulatory environments. You combine technical expertise with strong stakeholder management skills and are comfortable advising senior decision-makers. You thrive in international settings, communicate effectively, and maintain the highest standards of integrity and quality.
 

What We Offer
* A highly visible role with global impact across one of the world's leading logistics companies.
* Exposure to complex international insurance, tax, and compliance topics.
* Opportunities to collaborate with senior stakeholders across multiple functions and regions.
* A diverse, inclusive, and collaborative working environment.
* Continuous professional development and career growth opportunities within DHL Group.(Employer value proposition formulated based on the role's global scope and responsibilities.)

 

Why DHL Group?

At DHL Group, we are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can contribute and grow. We value diverse perspectives and believe that our people are the key to our success. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, skills, experience, and performance.
 

Your benefits
 
* Well-Being: Fun, team spirit, and health are crucial factors. Therefore, within the company, we offer a wide range of health and preventive care services, an occupational physician
* Family-friendly: The compatibility of family and work has many facets, such as childcare, care for family members, etc. We support this, for example, through kindergarten places as well as the Betreuungs- und Erholungswerk (support and recreation program).
* Employee Share Program: As an employee, you have the opportunity to participate in DHL Group's employee share program and share directly in the company's long-term success.
* Mobility: We move not only letters or parcels but also our employees through offerings such as company bicycles, job tickets and possibly company cars.
* Location: The Post Campus brings together people from more than 60 countries. The Post Tower is easily accessible by car, public transportation and bicycle. To facilitate the workday, the campus offers amenities such as parking spaces, post office, café, canteen and more.
* Onboarding: Individual onboarding, training on the job, networking, a dedicated certified program, etc., lay the foundation for a successful start at DHL Group.
* Development opportunities: We offer numerous development opportunities through a comprehensive training landscape, junior talent programs, coaching etc.
* Social commitment: Through global corporate programs, we improve the educational and career opportunities for young people and engage in disaster management at airports. We also contribute to local environmental protection and aid projects initiated by employees on a voluntary basis.
* What else? Company pension plan, social counseling, inclusion consulting, cleaning service, insurance cooperation, corporate discounts, events, sabbaticals and much more!

 

About DHL Group

DHL Group is the world’s leading logistics company, connecting people and businesses in more than 220 countries and territories through a comprehensive portfolio of logistics, e-commerce, parcel, express, freight forwarding, and supply chain management services.

With approximately 580,000 employees worldwide, DHL Group operates one of the largest global logistics networks.

Our purpose is simple: Connecting People. Improving Lives.
 

Apply now with your complete documents, stating your salary expectations, using the application button.
 

For further information, please visit careers.dhl.com. For initial personal contact and any questions, please contact Sven Rötzel at sven.roetzel@dhl.com or 0228-189-52128.
 

We look forward to receiving your application*.

CONNECTING PEOPLE. IMPROVING LIVES.
 

*At DHL Group, applications from all individuals are welcome, regardless of age, gender, origin, religion or physical attributes.

Who We Are 🌍

Limatica measures what batteries whisper. We turn the tiny voltage noise of battery cells into a quality verdict, far faster than conventional tests, and help cell manufacturers cut scrap.

We are a team of twelve in Chemnitz, spanning data, ML, HPC, hardware and industrialization. Early adopters across Europe and Asia already use our technology. In 2026 we move from pilots to production lines, and our data grows faster than our team.

What You'll Do 🔧

Our measurement stations produce several hundred GB of high-resolution voltage data per hour. You own the step from raw signal to reliable answer.

- Work with novel cell noise data: Derive features from raw time series that make physical sense that hold up in production
- Build for streaming: Design feature computations that work in streaming mode, at a throughput of up to 10,000 measurements per hour.
- **Make throughput a design decision:**Build modular, parameterizable nodes for our distributed processing pipeline and help bring them into our Rust-based production environment.
- **Ship modules, not scripts:**Automate evaluations end to end, from raw data to reports for our engineering team and our customers.
- Own customer projects technically: Assess requirements, communicate interim results and findings, and turn feedback into improvements.

What You Bring 🕵️

- Measurement experience: A degree in electrical engineering (or comparable) and 3+ years with real-world measurement data. Sampling, noise, filtering and artifacts you know from practice, not just lectures.
- Physical intuition: You can explain why a feature makes sense, and you prefer a simple, well-understood method over a model nobody can explain.
- Data at scale: You think in throughput: data formats, intermediate results, distributed and cached processing.
- Clean engineering: Python, Git, tests and CI/CD as a matter of course. No Rust expertise needed, but the will to learn it.
- Customer confidence: Fluent German and English, written and spoken. You explain results clearly to engineers and managers alike.

Why Limatica 🚀

- Real ownership: Your own part of the pipeline and your first customer project within months. As we grow, this role can grow into technical lead.
- Learn what few get to learn: Electrochemistry, Rust in production and data engineering at scale, with real cells and international manufacturers.
- Share the upside: Salary package including virtual stock options.
- Invest in yourself: Additional holiday for personal learning
- Flexibility & wellbeing: Flexible hours, hybrid work, further benefits via Guud Card

What it's like here: You get a lot of trust and a lot of room to shape things. We look for people who stay with a problem until it's solved and who enjoy the moments when a customer launch needs the whole team. Those are the moments where people here grow fastest. This role is intentionally a towards-senior position. You will take on increasing responsibility for pipeline modules and customer projects. Those who help shape the architecture and lead projects independently grow into a senior role with us.

jobs.description:
Position Overview

- Location: ISR International School on the Rhine, Neuss campus, with events at all ISR sites in Neuss, Düsseldorf, and Meerbusch
- Reports to: Head of Marketing 
- Employment type: Full-time
- Start date: as soon as possible

The Event Marketing Manager plans and delivers ISR's full event portfolio, from small community gatherings to large-scale events with up to 1,000 guests. Events are a core part of how ISR builds its community, attracts new families, and represents the school to universities, consulates, and partners. This role owns every event from concept to follow-up and supports the marketing team in day-to-day operations.

Key Roles & Responsibilities: 

Event planning and delivery

- Plan and run ISR’s internal and external events end to end, from community events, and consulate visits to university fairs, Open House and Info Days, the International Spring Festival, and cultural celebrations such as St. Martin’s Day, Halloween, Carnival, and Chinese New Year
- Build the annual event calendar in line with the academic year and admissions cycle
- Prepare run-of-show plans, manage events on site, and coordinate staff and volunteers
- Represent ISR at evening and weekend events, with compensatory time off according to school policy

Event communication and registrations

- Own all event communication from save-the-date to thank-you, and promote events across the website, social media, newsletters, and parent channels
- Set up and continuously monitor registrations, and follow up proactively with guests before and after each event
- Keep school leadership informed on registration numbers and hand over leads to the admissions team

Community and partnerships

- Work closely with school leadership, teachers, counselors, students, parents, and alumni, and host VIP and diplomatic guests
- Build long-term relationships with cooperation partners and sponsors, including co-hosted events, sponsorship packages, and internship formats with the University & Career Counseling team
- Maintain the partner database and identify opportunities for new partnerships

Budget and logistics

- Manage event budgets, permits, and licenses (e.g., GEMA), as well as the Marketing Storage Room
- Coordinate ISR’s US-style school bus for events, including scheduling, routes, and student supervision

Day-to-day marketing support

- Support the marketing team with content for the website, social media, and newsletters, as well as admissions campaigns
- Maintain marketing calendars and contact lists, and take on additional marketing tasks as needed

Qualifications and Experience

- Solid experience planning and running events, ideally including large events with several hundred guests or more
- Experience in an educational, nonprofit, or international setting, or in partnership management and sponsorship, is a plus
- Professional-level English and very good German skills
- Confident with Microsoft 365, AI tools, event registration tools, and social media
- Driver’s license
- Highly organized multitasker who can manage several events at once with close attention to detail
- Calm and solution-oriented under pressure and when plans change
- Friendly, professional, and poised presence with families, students, diplomats, and representatives
- Strong written communication skills and a proactive, reliable approach to follow-ups
- Intercultural awareness and genuine interest in a diverse school community
- Hands-on team player

At ISR, you will always be supported by committed, welcoming colleagues and confident, hardworking students. We eagerly anticipate witnessing your contributions to our vibrant educational community. In return, we are committed to providing you with a diverse array of opportunities for your professional growth and career development.

If the above description resonates with you, then please email your CV and cover letter to jobs@isr-school.de. (https://mailto:jobs@isr-school.de.)

jobs.description:
© Kletr / Fotolia The Helmholtz Centre for Environmental Research
(UFZ) is a world-leading institution in environmental research and a
member of the Helmholtz Association, Germany’s largest scientific
organisation. With approximately 1,200 employees across Leipzig,
Halle, and Magdeburg, we have been conducting research since 1991
using a transdisciplinary approach to address the most pressing
challenges of our time: biodiversity loss, climate change, and
environmental pollution. Our goal is to translate excellent research
into practical solutions for policymakers, business, and society, and
to serve as a reliable partner in supporting transformation processes
toward a sustainable and just future for current and future
generations. We foster a culture of collaboration, openness, and
diversity within a work environment that actively promotes creativity
and personal development. Scientific Project Coordinator (f/m/x)
Environmental Data and AI Platform (DataMon) The job DataMon is a new
strategic UFZ initiative to build an integrated environmental data and
AI platform that brings together established monitoring products,
scientific data services and cross-domain analytical capabilities. The
platform will make UFZ data products more accessible, interoperable
and AI-ready, while creating new opportunities for integrated
environmental research and knowledge transfer. As Scientific Project
Coordinator, you will play a central role in turning this ambitious
interdisciplinary initiative into a coherent implementation process,
connecting scientific, technical and organisational perspectives
across UFZ and with external partners. Your tasks Establish and
maintain the integrated DataMon roadmap across the shared platform,
monitor and data-product modules, and cross-cutting AI and
spatial-computing services. Work closely with module leads to clarify
requirements, resolve dependencies and conflicts, prepare decisions,
agree on priorities and next steps, and ensure consistent follow-up
across the DataMon portfolio. Coordinate milestones, deliverables,
dependencies, resource requirements, risks and decisions across module
leads, research data management, IT, knowledge transfer, research
infrastructure units, technical working groups and external service
providers. Translate scientific and user needs into clear technical
and organisational requirements, identify reusable solutions and
synergies across modules, and align priorities, interfaces and
implementation pathways. Prepare and facilitate Steering Group
meetings, readiness reviews and cross-project workshops; draft
decision papers and ensure that agreed actions are followed up and,
where necessary, escalated. Establish and maintain project controls
for schedules, risks, changes, decisions, reporting and documentation,
and prepare concise status and management reports. Support the
procurement and commissioning of external development services,
coordinate service providers, and monitor deliverables, acceptance
criteria and knowledge transfer in close cooperation with the
responsible UFZ units. Coordinate the transition from project
implementation to sustainable operation, including responsibilities,
update cycles, quality assurance, maintenance requirements and user
support. We offer The freedom to master even the most demanding
challenges between basic research and practical application The chance
to work in interdisciplinary, international teams and benefit from a
variety of perspectives First class integration into national and
international research networks to work together on global challenges
Excellent research infrastructure and research data management to
optimally support your work Flexible working hours and a wide range of
options for balancing work and care responsibilities through our
family office Competent support and advice for international
colleagues arriving at the UFZ from the 'International Office' Special
annual payment, capital-forming benefits and subsidised Germany Job
Ticket A workplace in a vibrant region with a high life quality and
social and cultural diversity Your profile An academic degree at
master’s level or equivalent in environmental or natural sciences,
computer or data science, geoinformatics, engineering, science and
technology management, or a related field Several years of experience
managing complex, interdisciplinary digital, research-infrastructure,
software or data-platform projects, including multi-team roadmaps,
deliverables, dependencies, risks and reporting Proven ability to lead
through influence, create commitment across organisational boundaries,
address conflicts constructively, prepare and facilitate decisions,
and ensure consistent follow-up A strong technical understanding of
data platforms and software development, interfaces and APIs, data and
metadata workflows, FAIR principles, cloud or compute environments,
and AI-enabled services. Hands-on coding experience is welcome, but
not essential Excellent facilitation, presentation, negotiation and
writing skills, with the ability to communicate confidently with
researchers, IT specialists, management, stakeholders and external
service providers A structured, independent and outcome-oriented
working style, sound judgement in evolving and complex project
settings, and experience with agile or hybrid project management
approaches Very good written and spoken English and German Experience
with public procurement, contract deliverables or external service
provider management is an advantage The UFZ values diversity and is
actively committed to ensuring equal opportunities for all employees,
regardless of their origin, religion, beliefs, disability, age or
sexual identity. We welcome people who represent diverse backgrounds,
identities and perspectives. We therefore particularly encourage
people who are affected by structural discrimination to apply to us.

provider of mobile sanitary solutions, with operations across Europe,
the USA and Asia. Our TOI TOI® and DIXI® brands are represented in

Act as the single point of contact between IT and business
stakeholders in the Czech Republic, Slovakia and Poland for all new
demands, projects and digital initiatives. Build strong relationships
with stakeholders at all levels, understand their requirements and
translate business needs into scalable, value-adding IT solutions
Identify opportunities for digitalisation and guide new demands from
initial concept through prioritisation and approval to successful
implementation Coordinate internal teams, external service providers

Develop and maintain project plans and documentation, monitor progress
and performance, and provide transparent status reporting Manage

with business priorities while continuously improving service quality
and measurable business value Keep stakeholders informed about project

Contribute ideas on digital trends and responsible AI use that improve

experience with common AI tools, such as Microsoft 365 Copilot or

solution-oriented approach Strong client-facing and communication
skills, with the confidence to engage effectively with stakeholders
from the shop floor to C-suite level A client-focused, proactive and
self-driven mindset with the ability to build trust and long-term
relationships Willingness to travel regularly within the region and,
where required, internationally Experience with project management
tools such as Microsoft Project or Smartsheet is an advantage; PRINCE2

Work from home or from our office in Ratingen (Germany) with flexible

Additional health benefits provided by the company. Comprehensive

jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com
The Position
Are you passionate about bringing innovation to our equine customers to improve the lives of horses and the people who love them? We're seeking for a customer focused, results driven business leader to join our global equine business to continue building and leading a customer centric innovation roadmap in line with the business segment strategy.
This is an important leadership position within the global equine team. You will foster cross-functional collaboration together with R&D, Supply, Regions and Countries and move Innovation/Business Development projects forward. You will lead the commercial perspective of projects, support long-term pipeline forecasting, and manage strategic business model innovation initiatives.
If you believe that this is the next career move for you, we look forward to receiving your dedicated application and getting to know you further!
This position has a hybrid setup with at least three days per week on site.
Tasks & responsibilities

- In this role, you will work closely with Global Head Equine GSM, Equine Franchise Managers and Technical Service Managers to ensure that a consistent overall innovation roadmap is put together and implemented in line with Business Segment strategy.
- As part of this you will be responsible for driving the GSM input on BD&L and R&D potential pipeline opportunities in alignment with the Business Segment Strategy.
- Your lateral leadership skills will help you to foster cross-functional collaboration together with R&D, Supply, Regions and Countries teams for internal innovation and BD&L projects.
- You will champion the Global Strategic Marketing (GSM) needs during project development management within project teams, leading commercial perspective in projects and drive the GSM input into appropriate prioritization for research projects within sub-franchise portfolio including project status tracking and stakeholder communications.
- You will lead commercial input into product profiles from strategic and business perspectives.
- Finally, in close collaboration with Global Head Equine GSM and franchise managers, you will derive global forecasting assumptions and review / align them with key countries as needed.

Requirements

- Master degree in the field of Veterinary science or similar required.
- Highly specialized knowledge and experience in the field of equine health with a deep understanding of the therapeutic and veterinary science areas and customer needs in this field
- Strong lateral leadership skills to foster cross-functional work
- Ability to communicate decisions to senior stakeholders in an international/cross-cultural matrix environment
- Strong financial and business acumen
- Strong strategic and analytical capabilities
- Excellent knowledge of English, further languages of advantage

With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

Ready to contact us?
If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.com

About us European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) GmbH is
the joint venture between TSMC, Bosch, Infineon and NXP. For the first
time, global technology leader TSMC is building a semiconductor fab in
the heart of Europe, offering cutting-edge manufacturing technologies
for next-generation semiconductor products. ESMC represents a shared
commitment to strengthening the European semiconductor ecosystem. For
our future fab in Dresden, we are looking for a highly motivated and
committed: AMHS Hardware Engineer (m/w/d) Become the heart of our fab
automation. The Automated Material Handling System (AMHS) will be the
nervous system of our fab. As an AMHS Hardware Engineer, you’ll be a
technical expert, designer, problem-solver, and team leader. You’ll
ensure that our wafer transport systems (transfer tools, sorters, N2
systems) operate at maximum efficiency. Tasks Your Mission: Take the
lead on hardware performance and drive technological development:
System Optimization & Setup: You will be responsible for the
installation, commissioning, and continuous improvement of our AMHS
hardware. In-Depth Troubleshooting: For complex issues, you will
conduct root cause analyses (8D, FMEA, SPC) and implement sustainable
solutions. Project Management: You will lead cross-functional projects
aimed at improving productivity, quality, and cost efficiency—from
planning through to performance review. Technology Scouting: You will
evaluate new equipment and materials, work closely with suppliers, and
develop in-house hardware solutions to meet operational needs.
Leadership & Mentoring: You will lead and mentor a team of technicians
and junior engineers, share your knowledge, and foster team spirit
through clear communication. Fab Setup: You will actively assist with
installation and coordinate upgrades in close collaboration with other
departments. Profile You are a proactive team player who thrives in a
dynamic, fast-paced environment and is willing to take on
responsibility. Qualifications: A Master’s degree in Engineering,
such as Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, Automation, or a related
field. Experience: Professional experience in the semiconductor
industry is required. Technical expertise: In-depth knowledge of
optimization algorithms, control systems, and mechanical automation.
Methodological skills: Proficiency in quality tools such as SPC, FMEA,
and 8D problem-solving. Personality: Hands-on mentality, resilience,
and the ability to motivate and lead teams professionally. Language:
Fluent in English (company language). Basic communication skills in
Mandarin or German is a plus. Training: Available for on-the-job
training in Taiwan, 9 to 12 months. Location: Dresden, Germany We
offer Each journey starts with a first step. Joining ESMC at this
early stage will provide you with the unique opportunity to actively
shape the future of the fab in Dresden, boost your career and put your
true potential to the test. You will be working in a fast paced,
international startup environment whilst at the same time having
access to the experience, talent, and resources of the largest and
most advanced semiconductor manufacturer in the world, TSMC. You have
ample opportunities to learn about TSMC Operations, Digital
Transformation, and various advanced Facilities related topics, both
in Taiwan and other sites around the world. Behind the world’s most
advanced technology are real people with real passion. Our success is
fueled by our core values: Integrity, Commitment, Innovation and
Customer Trust (ICIC). At ESMC we believe in the power of inclusive
leadership and passion. We demonstrate this in our commitment to our
people vision: create an inclusive environment to inspire passion and
enable the best in YOU. It is the policy of ESMC to provide equal
employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color,
ethnic and national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental
disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation,
gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital
status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or
any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law.
Additional contact details Please apply with your English resume. The
ESMC recruiting team will get in touch with you if your candidacy fits
the hiring criteria.

jobs.occupation: Senior HR Specialist - Apprenticeship & Vocational Training (m/f/d) (Ausbildungsberater/in)
jobs.description:
About us The European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) GmbH
is a joint venture between TSMC, Bosch, Infineon, and NXP. For the
first time, TSMC, the global technology leader, is establishing a
semiconductor fabrication plant in the heart of Europe, offering
leading-edge manufacturing technologies for next-generation
semiconductor products. ESMC represents a shared commitment to
strengthening the European semiconductor ecosystem. For our future fab
in Dresden, we are looking for a highly motivated and dedicated:
Senior HR Specialist - Apprenticeship & Vocational Training (m/f/d)
Are you ready to strategically and pedagogically lead the end-to-end
apprentice journey for Europe's newest, most advanced semiconductor
facility? As a Senior HR Specialist - Apprenticeship & Vocational
Training (m/f/d) at ESMC in Dresden, you will move beyond standard
administration to drive collaborative success across all core phases
of our technical vocational education. You will be the architect of
our future talent pipeline— managing employer branding at schools,
coordinating dual-training plans, mentoring Gen-Z apprentices, and
ensuring legal compliance. Fitting into our fast-paced greenfield
environment, this role offers a unique opportunity to shape the next
generation of microtechnology and industrial specialists from the
ground up! Tasks Talent Attraction & Recruitment: Design and execute
targeted school marketing strategies, represent ESMC at career fairs,
manage the applicant pipeline, conduct interviews, and issue
apprenticeship contracts. Onboarding & Pastoral Care: Serve as the
primary point of contact and dedicated mentor for future apprentices,
coordinating orientation phases and providing continuous coaching.
Training Curriculum Coordination: Design dual-training plans, manage
internal rotations across manufacturing departments, and coordinate
closely with local vocational schools (Berufsschulen).
Train-the-Trainer Support: Provide ongoing pedagogical and structured
guidance to our operational Fab trainers on the manufacturing floor.
Legal Compliance: Ensure full operational compliance with the German
Vocational Training Act (BBiG), the Youth Employment Protection Act
(JArbSchG), and other relevant educational laws. Key Stakeholder
Management: Build and maintain excellent collaborative relationships
with the local Works Council (Betriebsrat/JAV), vocational schools,
and local chambers (IHK). Graduation & Placement: Coordinate final
exam preparations, align with department managers to map out
post-graduation career pathways, and handle transition contract
processes. Profile Must-Have: Certifications: Holder of the AdA-Schein
(AEVO / Ausbildereignungsprüfung)—the mandatory qualification to
train apprentices in Germany. Education: Academic degree (B.Sc./M.Sc.)
or certified technical expert background (Staatlich geprüfter
Techniker) with a verified trainer/tester license. Experience: 5+
years of professional experience managing vocational training programs
within a technical, manufacturing, or industrial environment (e.g.,
semiconductor, automotive, automation, or chemical industries).
Regulatory & Institutional Knowledge: Strong, practical experience
working successfully with the IHK and a deep understanding of German
legal frameworks (BBiG, JArbSchG, and BetrVG). Languages: Fluent
German (C1/C2) is mandatory for official communications with
authorities, schools, and parents. Strong English skills (B2/C1) are
required for internal collaboration in our international corporate
environment. Pedagogical Drive: Exceptional communication skills with
the ability to motivate, resolve conflicts, and guide Gen-Z young
adults through their personal and professional development.
Nice-to-Have: Familiarity with cleanroom environments, semiconductor
fab safety regulations, and the technical demands of Microtechnology
(Mikrotechnologe/In). Experience setting up apprenticeship structures
in a fast-growing, ramp-up corporate environment. We offer Security &
Perspective: A permanent employment contract and career advancement
opportunities in one of Europe's leading semiconductors fabs. Company
Pension Plan & Financial Benefits: We support your financial
well-being with our robust company pension plan. As an ESMC employee,
you also benefit directly from TSMC’s performance through an
exclusive Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP). Relocation Support for
Dresden: Moving for us? We’ll provide you with all the support you
will need for your relocation and your start in Dresden. Training &
Development: At the TSMC Newcomer Training Center, gain a deeper
understanding of the processes involved in operating complex
semiconductor equipment through unique hands-on training, while you
continuously expand your knowledge. Health & Well-Being: An annual
budget for your health and well-being (e.g., for sports classes,
massages, or relaxation) helps you stay fit. Meals & Transportation:
Enjoy a daily meal allowance as well as a subsidized public
transportation (e.g., for the Deutschlandticket). Additional contact
details Please apply with your English resume.
